blocks.html: Buildings with a rooftop garden, landscaped roof, green roof, or roof used for any purpose other than weather protection or maintenance that are equipped with a standpipe system shall extend the standpipe system to the roof level on which the rooftop garden, landscaped roof, green roof, or roof used for any purpose other than weather protection or maintenance is located.
